description: One page of conversation metadata for the active or archived scope. Rows are normalized to ChatRef; a malformed row fails the page instead of being dropped.
observation_recipe: open https://chatgpt.com/ and record the conversations request for the active scope
open the Archived section and record the request with is_archived=true
scroll to record a second page with a larger offset
verification_cases: identity: conversation ids come from the response items
paging: offset advances by the number of rows actually returned
archived scope: is_archived=true is sent only for the archived scope
timestamps: epoch seconds and ISO-8601 values normalize to epoch milliseconds
shape drift: a malformed row fails the run instead of dropping the chat
auth failure: a 401 refreshes the session once, then stops the run
rate limit: a 429 retries with backoff and stops after the retry budget
